story:
Core Concrete Construction LLC is a residential and commercial concrete contractor working out of Plainfield, Indiana, across the whole Indianapolis metro. We install driveways, patios, walkways, slabs and garage floors, and we finish them the way you want them — broom, stamped, textured or exposed aggregate. Alongside the flatwork we take on concrete sealing and leveling, hardscaping, culvert replacement, drainage installation and asphalt paving.

The part customers tend to talk about is not the concrete. It is that someone came out and measured the job quickly, that the quote arrived when it was promised, that the crew turned up when they said they would and finished in a day, and that the yard was clean when they left. Our estimators — Nick and Connor — stay on your job from the first measurement through to the final walk-through, so the person who wrote your scope is the person checking it was built. We keep a full-time permitting manager on staff, because filing with Marion County, Hendricks County or the Town of Plainfield is our problem and not yours.

That approach has earned us HomeAdvisor's Partner of the Year award and Super Service Awards in 2022, 2023 and 2024, membership of the Builders Association of Greater Indianapolis, and a 5.00 average across 69 customer reviews. Estimates are always free and there is never an obligation to book.
